columns.name: APPROVAL_OPTIONS_ID
columns.description: Primary key and unique identifier

columns.name: AI_COMMENT_ENABLED
columns.description: Store AI Comment feature is enabled or not.

columns.name: ARCHIVE_PERIOD
columns.description: Duration after which a completed transaction for the approval process can be moved from main transaction store to the archive data store.

columns.name: PURGE_PERIOD
columns.description: Duration after which an archived transaction for the approval process becomes a candidate to be purged from the system.

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HRC_ARM_PROCESS tables.

columns.name: APPROVAL_DISABLED
columns.description: Flag to indicate if approvals are disabled for an approval process.

columns.name: ASYNC_BYPASS_ENABLED
columns.description: Store async bypass is enabled or not

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SGUID
columns.description: The seed global unique identifier. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ALERT_ENABLED
columns.description: Used as a check before triggering alerts automatically

columns.name: SEND_TO_USERS
columns.description: This is used to store whether the alerts should be sent to individual users or not

columns.name: ALERT_TEMPLATE_OBJECT_GUID
columns.description: This is used for maintaining consistency of seeed data framework.

columns.name: IS_PARALLEL_TXN_ENABLED
columns.description: Used to store user preference of enabling/disabling Parallel Transactions.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
